description: A condition on `$` and a condition on a capture become ready at one advance. They run in their written order: the `$` condition fails first, so the capture condition, which would be an error of the grammar, never runs, and the text is rejected (engine §4).
grammar:
%rule text (A x)
%rule x $y:B %conditions $.source-text = "q", Z ⊆ $y.tokens-after-first.tags(migration-fault)

%rule migration-fault ε | {_} %conditions "x" ∈ $.value.split($.value)
